comment: end.c really_done() witness for a death after a hangup (done_hup set, end.c:1149-1151). In debug mode an elven Wizard wishes for a blessed spellbook of drain life and two blessed potions of gain energy, drinks both, learns the spell, and casts it east by answering the direction prompt with the simulated-mouse key '_' and picking a spot with getpos(). ^A repeats the cast: getspell() and getdir() take 'c' and '_' from CQ_REPEAT, docast() appends 'c' to that queue again, and getpos() takes it as an unknown direction before reading the keyboard through pgetchar() with in_doagain set. The 0377 bytes make readchar_core() call hangup(), which swaps in the no-op window procedures and returns ESC; getpos() fails, so getdir() clears u.dx, u.dy and u.dz, spelleffects() reuses that direction, and the spell drains the level-1 hero, whose losexp() calls done(DIED). With done_hup set, done() skips the wizard-mode 'Die?' query (end.c:1110), and really_done() sets done_stopprint, so nothing more is drawn.
